rationale: The current best stops training at the reserved final-eval deadline, so the existing LR warmdown is keyed to the wrong endpoint and usually never affects the quant-aware endgame. This surgical patch keeps the recurrent-tail model, export budget, validation path, and print formats intact while making warmdown target the actual train deadline before final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact.
title: Train-Budget Quant-Aware Warmdown
